sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the complete DIRECT_STATIC contract: applicability, inclusive 12 nautical-mile threshold, qualifying ice concentrations with UNITLESS units and > 0.1 comparisons, distinct recorded distance quantities, and the prohibition on food-waste discharge. The prior duplicate-value and missing ice-concentration obligations are addressed; no vocabulary repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the conditional constraints to reject any nonconforming duplicate values rather than merely requiring one conforming value: the current FILTER NOT EXISTS patterns let a ship pass when both a compliant and a noncompliant distance, concentration, or foodWasteDischargeOntoIce value are present. Constrain the applicable quantity properties to a single recorded value (or explicitly reject every value below the 12 nmi threshold, every nearby concentration at or below 0.1, and every true food-waste-discharge value), while retaining the required minimum recording checks. Ensure the conditional distance-from-ice-area value is required in the applicable case and remains distinct from the nearest-fast-ice threshold value. No vocabulary matcher is needed.

Continue the prior repair: the duplicate checks still do not reject every nonconforming numeric value when one quantity node contains both compliant and noncompliant values, because the nested FILTER NOT EXISTS suppresses the bad-value detection whenever that same node also has a compliant value. Reject every distanceToNearestFastIce value below 12 nautical miles and every nearbyIceConcentration value at or below 0.1, while retaining applicable-case recording, decimal datatype, and required units; do not permit a mixed compliant/noncompliant value set to pass. Ensure the applicable distanceFromAreaWithIceConcentrationAboveOneTenth and the qualifying concentration are both required in the Antarctic-discharge case, with the two recorded quantities remaining distinct from the nearest-fast-ice quantity. No vocabulary matcher is needed.

The candidate is structurally valid and its maxCount constraints address the prior duplicate-value issue, but it omits the declared directConstraintTerms entry nltl:iceConcentration from the COMPLETE dependency contract. Encode the required ice-concentration input/constraint explicitly, with the canonical QuantityValue range, UNITLESS unit, and the > 0.1 comparison, while retaining the applicable distance recording, >= 12 nautical-mile threshold, prohibition, applicability logic, and distinct distance quantities. No vocabulary matcher is needed.

The candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the complete DIRECT_STATIC contract: applicability, inclusive 12 nautical-mile threshold, qualifying ice concentrations with UNITLESS units and > 0.1 comparisons, distinct recorded distance quantities, and the prohibition on food-waste discharge. The prior duplicate-value and missing ice-concentration obligations are addressed; no vocabulary repair is required.
